hooks.command: $json = $input | Out-String | ConvertFrom-Json; $msg = [string]$json.user_message; $first = if ($msg.Length -gt 0) { $msg[0] } else { '' }; if ($first -eq '*' -or $first -eq '#' -or $msg -match '^/') { exit 0 }; $words = ($msg.Trim() -split '\s+').Count; if ($words -gt 15) { exit 0 }; Write-Output '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"Short or vague prompt detected. If unclear, use /polish-prompt to refine before executing."}}'
